# REHVO (https://rehvo.in)

> REHVO is India's premier AI-powered, zero-brokerage rental real estate ecosystem and verified housing network.

## Description
REHVO connects prospective tenants directly with verified property owners, flatmates, and co-living operators without middleman fees or fake broker listings. Every property on REHVO undergoes multi-tiered verification including Index-II title deeds, municipal utility validation, and physical walkthrough checks.

## Geographic Coverage
- **Mumbai**: Andheri West, Bandra West, Powai, Andheri East, BKC, Worli, Juhu, Lower Parel, Thane, Navi Mumbai.
- **Pune**: Hinjewadi, Kharadi, Viman Nagar, Baner, Kothrud.
- **Bangalore**: Koramangala, Indiranagar, HSR Layout, Whitefield, Bellandur.
- **Delhi NCR**: Gurgaon Cyber City, South Delhi, Noida Sector 62, Dwarka.
- **Hyderabad**: Gachibowli, Hitec City, Madhapur, Kondapur.

## Core Features
- **Zero Brokerage Guarantee**: No broker commissions or hidden agency fees.
- **100% Deed-Verified Listings**: Verification via government land records (Index-II) and electricity bills.
- **AI Concierge & Matchmaking**: Instantaneous renter-homeowner and flatmate compatibility matching.
- **HD & 4K ShowReels**: Immersive video walkthroughs providing verified spatial context prior to in-person visits.
- **Low & Zero-Deposit Program**: Modern rental security deposit alternatives.

## Supported Canonical URL Patterns
- Base Domain: https://rehvo.in
- Verified Property Detail: https://rehvo.in/property/[slug]
